request.subject: UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colour of the cloth: recolour the dark grey-blue hood and robe to a soft violet-leaning indigo blue: colour #5c55c6 on the lit left side, #4a43b5 on the rest, and #372f8f only in the deepest folds; no navy, no black and no purple on the cloth. Keep the two big round cream eyes, the candle with its small green flame, the paper scroll, the badge, the slippers, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
